passage.text: What do young Thais dream of today?
passage.reading: ˈwʌt duː ˈjʌŋ ˈtaɪz ˈdriːm əv təˈdeɪ?

passage.text: We asked three university students in Bangkok about their plans for the future.
passage.reading: wiː ˈæskt ˈθriː ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈstuːdənts ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk əˈbaʊt ðɛr ˈplænz fər ðə ˈfjuːtʃər.

passage.text: Arm, 21, studies engineering and wants a stable job at a big company.
passage.reading: ˈɑːrm, ˈtwɛnti ˈwʌn, ˈstʌdiz ˌɛndʒɪˈnɪrɪŋ ənd ˈwɑːnts ə ˈsteɪbəl ˈdʒɑːb ət ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkʌmpəni.

passage.text: "My parents worked very hard for me, so now I want to look after them," he says.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈpɛrənts ˈwɜːrkt ˈvɛri ˈhɑːrd fər miː, ˈsoʊ ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈlʊk ˈæftər ðɛm, hiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "For me, financial security is more important than following my dreams."
passage.reading: fər miː, faɪˈnænʃəl sɪˈkjʊrəti ɪz ˈmɔːr ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ðən ˈfɑːloʊɪŋ maɪ ˈdriːmz.

passage.text: Fern, 20, is an art student who already works as a freelance designer.
passage.reading: ˈfɜːrn, ˈtwɛnti, ɪz ən ˈɑːrt ˈstuːdənt huː ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈwɜːrks əz ə ˈfriːlæns dɪˈzaɪnər.

passage.text: "I can choose my own projects and work from anywhere," she explains.
passage.reading: aɪ kən ˈtʃuːz maɪ ˈoʊn ˈprɑːdʒɛkts ənd ˈwɜːrk frəm ˈɛniwɛr, ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnz.

passage.text: "My income isn't stable, but I love the freedom."
passage.reading: maɪ ˈɪnkʌm ˈɪzənt ˈsteɪbəl, bʌt aɪ ˈlʌv ðə ˈfriːdəm.

passage.text: Nat, 22, studies business and dreams of starting his own company.
passage.reading: ˈnæt, ˈtwɛnti ˈtuː, ˈstʌdiz ˈbɪznəs ənd ˈdriːmz əv ˈstɑːrtɪŋ hɪz ˈoʊn ˈkʌmpəni.

passage.text: "Our generation grew up online, so we can sell things to people around the world," he says.
passage.reading: aʊr ˌdʒɛnəˈreɪʃən ˈɡruː ˈʌp ˌɑːnˈlaɪn, soʊ wiː kən ˈsɛl ˈθɪŋz tə ˈpiːpəl əˈraʊnd ðə ˈwɜːrld, hiː ˈsɛz.

passage.text: "I don't want a boss. I want to be the boss!"
passage.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt ə ˈbɔːs. aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə bi ðə ˈbɔːs!

passage.text: Three students, three different dreams, but they all agree on one thing: hard work comes first.
passage.reading: ˈθriː ˈstuːdənts, ˈθriː ˈdɪfərənt ˈdriːmz, bʌt ðeɪ ˈɔːl əˈɡriː ɑːn ˈwʌn ˈθɪŋ: ˈhɑːrd ˈwɜːrk ˈkʌmz ˈfɜːrst.
